Halloween at Continental. Brown Buoy all night. Bollywood bangers, wicked looks, and a curse worth staying out for.

About this Event

DESIBEATZ PRESENTS
SHRAAP 🕷️
Some curses are worth staying out for.
SHRAAP means curse. Consider your Halloween plans sealed.
On Saturday, October 31, bring your alter ego to Continental, San Jose. The costume that turns heads. The friends who sing every word. The night you’ll still be talking about when the makeup comes off.
BROWN BUOY handles the soundtrack. All. Night. Long.
WHAT TO EXPECT
🎧 BROWN BUOY FROM START TO FINISH
Brown Buoy in control from 10 PM to 1:30 AM—from the first drop to the final anthem.
🔥 BOLLYWOOD AFTER DARK
Club anthems, throwback singalongs, and those “play that again” favorites. Come ready to lose your voice.
🕷️ DRESS LIKE YOU MEAN IT
Sinister, seductive, outrageous—bring your Halloween alter ego to life. Costumes HIGHLY encouraged.
Your darkest look. Your loudest crew. One cursed night.
WHEN & WHERE
📅 Saturday, October 31, 2026
⏰ 10 PM–1:30 AM
📍 Continental — 349 S 1st St, San Jose, CA
TICKETS & BOTTLE SERVICE
$10 Early Bird tickets — secure yours before prices go up.General admission prices will increase. Book early for the best price.$300 bottle service for 6 guests — make it a night with your crew.No free guestlist.ENTRY & POLICIES
21+ only. Valid government-issued photo ID required.All ticket sales are final. No refunds.PHOTO & VIDEO DISCLAIMER
Photography and video recording will take place during the event. By attending, you consent to being photographed or filmed and to the use of your image in event recaps, social media, and promotional materials for Desibeatz and Brown Buoy.
Be there for the first drop. Stay for the last.
Get your tickets. Meet your curse.
NO REFUNDS
